description: Land Acquisition - Puswellegama, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the state for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
